name: contentos
description: ContentOS — B2B LinkedIn image content operating system

scripts.install:api: cd apps/api && python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -U pip setuptools wheel && .venv/bin/pip install -e '.[dev]'
scripts.build:marketing: cd apps/marketing && npm ci && npm run build
scripts.lint: npm run lint:web && npm run lint:marketing && npm run lint:api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:web && npm run typecheck:marketing
scripts.synth:dev: npm run build:layer && npm run build:web:deploy && npm run build:marketing && cd infra && ./scripts/deploy.sh dev synth
scripts.deploy:dev: npm run build:layer && npm run build:web:deploy && npm run build:marketing && cd infra && ./scripts/deploy.sh dev deploy && ./scripts/publish-web.sh dev
scripts.deploy:qa: npm run build:layer && npm run build:web:deploy && npm run build:marketing && cd infra && ./scripts/deploy.sh qa deploy && ./scripts/publish-web.sh qa
scripts.deploy:prod: npm run build:layer && npm run build:web:deploy && npm run build:marketing && cd infra && ./scripts/deploy.sh prod deploy && ./scripts/publish-web.sh prod
